meta.name: anvil-node
meta.description: Run local Ethereum nodes with Anvil. Use when setting up local development environments, forking mainnet for testing, or running integration tests against a local node.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 启动本地以太坊节点,让合约开发与测试随时可跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你写以太坊智能合约,需要一个本地测试节点
copy.tagline_en: Run a local Ethereum node for development and testing.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop Ethereum contracts and need a local node.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以通过 Anvil 启动本地以太坊节点,预设 10 个有余额的测试账户,支持分叉主网、调整账户/挖矿/时间等参数,并用 RPC 命令配合测试或前端开发。
howto.when: 当你要求搭建本地以太坊开发环境、分叉主网做测试,或针对本地节点跑集成测试时触发。

say.text: 用 Anvil 在 8545 端口启动一个本地以太坊节点
say.note: Claude 会给出启动命令并说明默认配置。

say.text: 用 Anvil 分叉主网,指定区块高度 18000000 做测试
用 anvil_impersonateAccount 模拟一个以太坊巨鲸账户转账

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Anvil to start local Ethereum nodes, preset 10 funded test accounts, fork mainnet, adjust accounts/mining/time parameters, and interact via RPC for testing or frontend development.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to set up a local Ethereum development environment, fork mainnet for testing, or run integration tests against a local node.

say_en.text: Start a local Ethereum node with Anvil on port 8545
say_en.note: Claude will provide the startup command and default settings.

say_en.text: Fork mainnet with Anvil at block height 18000000 for testing
say_en.note: Claude will show commands using --fork-url and --fork-block-number.

say_en.text: Impersonate an Ethereum whale account with anvil_impersonateAccount
say_en.note: Claude will demonstrate unlocking the account and sending via cast send.
